The TSWV reference shows scattered small dark necrotic spots across the leaf with bronzing — this matches the test image well. Both show scattered small lesions with blurred margins across the leaf surface and similar mottled discoloration.

The test image is consistent with TSWV: scattered small spots/necrotic lesions with indistinct margins, bronzing, no concentric rings or powdery growth.
